name: Tab Group Commander
description: Manage, save, restore, and move your Chrome tab groups with powerful keyboard shortcuts.

move-group-to-another-window.description: Move current tab group to another window

move-group-to-new-window.description: Move current tab group to a new window

toggle-collapse-group.description: Collapse or expand the current tab group

switch-to-next-group.description: Switch to the next tab group

save-to-slot-1.description: Save current tab group to Slot 1

switch-to-slot-1.description: Switch to or recreate the group in Slot 1

save-to-slot-2.description: Save current tab group to Slot 2

switch-to-slot-2.description: Switch to or recreate the group in Slot 2

save-to-slot-3.description: Save current tab group to Slot 3

switch-to-slot-3.description: Switch to or recreate the group in Slot 3

save-to-slot-4.description: Save current tab group to Slot 4

switch-to-slot-4.description: Switch to or recreate the group in Slot 4

save-to-slot-5.description: Save current tab group to Slot 5

switch-to-slot-5.description: Switch to or recreate the group in Slot 5
